script: This is proof that Kobe Bryant couldn't guard Stephen Curry when... When Kobe Bryant guarded MJ, he blocked him and stripped the ball away from him. Same thing happened when Kobe guarded LeBron. LeBron attacked the basket, but Kobe met him at the rim and blocked the shot. But when Kobe guarded Stephen Curry, it was different. Kobe played tight defense the entire possession, yet Curry simply pulled up from 3 right over him and knocked it down. Kobe respected Curry after that incredible shot.
